item.skt: shU n+ya tA sap+ta ti ka br-it+ti
item.coloph: stong nyid bdun cu pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /stong nyi bdun cu'i 'grel pa ni/ dge slong d+harma grags kyis bsgyur/ gzhung grang stong phrag gnyis dang ni/ brgya phrag gcig gis lhag pa yin/ dpal nA len+d+ra'i gtsug lag khang du paN+Di ta a b+ha ya ka ra dang / snur lo tsA ba d+harma grags kyis bsgyur pa'o
